description.en: Jinzhou , formerly Chinchow, is a coastal prefecture-level city in central-west Liaoning province, China. It is a geographically strategic city located in the Liaoxi Corridor, which connects most of the land transports between North China and Northeast China, and is the economic center of western Liaoning.
description.zh-CN: 锦州市，简称锦，是中华人民共和国辽宁省下辖的地级市，位于辽宁中西部。市境西接葫芦岛市，北临朝阳市、阜新市，东北界沈阳市，东南邻鞍山市、盘锦市，南滨辽东湾。
description.zh-TW: 錦州市，簡稱錦，是中華人民共和國遼寧省下轄的地級市，位於遼寧中西部。市境西接葫蘆島市，北臨朝陽市、阜新市，東北界瀋陽市，東南鄰鞍山市、盤錦市，南濱遼東灣。

description.en: Bijia Mountain is an island located in the Liaodong Bay of China's Bohai Sea, south of the coast of the Jinzhou region of the Liaoning province, coastal China. During most times of the day, Bijiashan can only be accessed by boat.
description.zh-CN: 笔架山位于中国辽宁省锦州市南35公里的辽东湾中，紧邻锦州港，是一座近海中的陆连岛。南北长1.5公里，东西宽0.8公里，总面积约1平方公里。
description.zh-TW: 筆架山位於中國遼寧省錦州市南35公里的遼東灣中，緊鄰錦州港，是一座近海中的陸連島。南北長1.5公里，東西寬0.8公里，總面積約1平方公里。

photo.alt: This is a photo of Bijia Mountain at high tide, near en:Jinzhou City in en:Liaoning, en:China. At low tide, a land-bridge appears between the mainland and the mountain, allowing visitors to walk from one shore to the other. (This Jinzhou is near the northern tip of Liaoning Bay; not to be confused with Jinzhou District of Dalian city, on Jinzhou Bay, about 200km to the south.

description.en: Fengguo Temple is a Buddhist temple located in Yixian, Liaoning Province, China. The temple was first founded in 1020 during the Liao dynasty , and grew quite large during the subsequent centuries.
description.zh-CN: 奉国寺位于辽宁省锦州市义县县城内东街北侧，始建于辽开泰九年，初名咸熙寺；金改奉国寺；因大殿内供有过去七佛，所以又名“大佛寺”或“七佛寺”。1961年被列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位，是中国仅存的三大辽代寺院之一。
description.zh-TW: 奉國寺位於遼寧省錦州市義縣縣城內東街北側，始建於遼開泰九年，初名鹹熙寺；金改奉國寺；因大殿內供有過去七佛，所以又名“大佛寺”或“七佛寺”。1961年被列爲第一批全國重點文物保護單位，是中國僅存的三大遼代寺院之一。
